thesis: The speaker explains that his journey into behavioral economics began after sustaining severe burns, where he discovered that nurses incorrectly prioritized minimizing the duration of pain over minimizing its intensity, a flaw in their intuition that he later validated through research. He states that his broader research path involves identifying situations where human intuitions about the right course of action are faulty and determining what actions should be taken instead to align with reality.
